description: Source code implementing memory management functions for BoringSSL, including malloc, free, realloc, and related utilities, with support for sanitizers, custom allocators, and testing hooks.

methods.name: OPENSSL_malloc
methods.description: Allocates memory with optional sanitizer support and custom allocators.

methods.name: OPENSSL_free
methods.description: Frees memory allocated by OPENSSL_malloc or custom allocators.

methods.name: OPENSSL_realloc
methods.description: Reallocates memory with support for custom allocators.

methods.name: OPENSSL_cleanse
methods.description: Securely zeroes memory to prevent data leakage.

methods.name: CRYPTO_secure_malloc_initialized
methods.description: Stub for checking secure malloc initialization.

methods.name: CRYPTO_secure_used
methods.description: Stub for secure malloc usage reporting.

methods.name: OPENSSL_secure_clear_free
methods.description: Stub for secure free after cleansing.

methods.name: OPENSSL_strnlen
methods.description: Calculates string length up to a maximum.

methods.name: OPENSSL_isdigit
methods.description: Checks if character is a digit.

methods.name: OPENSSL_isxdigit
methods.description: Checks if character is a hexadecimal digit.

methods.name: OPENSSL_fromxdigit
methods.description: Converts hex digit character to numeric value.

methods.name: OPENSSL_strncasecmp
methods.description: Case-insensitive string comparison up to n characters.

methods.name: OPENSSL_strndup
methods.description: Duplicates a string with maximum length.
